project_type: Monorepo: (a) Node.js Express service mgmt/server-render (public chatbot backend, deployed on Render.com); (b) SvelteKit 5 static public frontend Public/frontend-v6 (chat widget + portal), deployed on Vercel via CI.
language: JavaScript (ESM) for server-render; TypeScript + Svelte 5 for frontend-v6
build_system: npm in each subproject. PATH must PREPEND /root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin (node v22.23.2).
test_framework: server-render: node:test (.mjs files in mgmt/server-render/test/, run via `npm test`). frontend-v6: vitest with jsdom (co-located *.test.ts), plus svelte-check via `npm run check`.
build_command: server-render: `cd mgmt/server-render && npm ci` (no separate build). frontend-v6: `cd Public/frontend-v6 && npm ci && npm run build`.
test_command: server-render: `cd mgmt/server-render && npm test` (baseline 221 pass / 0 fail). frontend-v6: `cd Public/frontend-v6 && npm run check` (0 errors/0 warnings) + `npm test` (vitest, baseline 309 pass).
verification_instructions: 1) Render: `cd mgmt/server-render && npm ci && npm test` must stay green (>=221 + new tests). 2) Frontend: `cd Public/frontend-v6 && npm ci && npm run check` (0/0) + `npm test` (all pass) + `npm run build`. 3) CI job `public-frontend-v6` enforces client JS-size budget: total bytes must stay <= 700,000 (baseline ~638,706 B). After build, verify total client JS bytes under budget.
snapshot_or_generated_files: frontend-v6 build outputs to .svelte-kit/output (gitignored / build artifact). No checked-in snapshots to regenerate.
setup_instructions: export PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH"; then npm ci in each subproject as above.
environment_constraints: Work happens on a NEW branch off main (do NOT push/PR). Both suites run fully offline (fetch stubbed in server tests; jsdom in FE). No DB migration involved. Model switch to Gemini primary is already live in provider config.
contribution_requirements: Keep both suites green. Render context builders stay CACHE-ONLY (no new fetch/D1). Preserve ID->name resolution, per-person blocks, document links, year-scoped retrieval, resell double-count note, and the PR#407 JOURNEY section + single-language directive. Do NOT change the frontend send/timeout/linkify logic from PR#406 (links must still render).
key_patterns: Server 503 responses: budget exhausted returns HTTP 503 {ok:false,error:'The chatbot has reached today’s usage limit...'}; busy/concurrency returns 503 'busy right now'; per-IP rate limit returns 429; model failure returns 502. Frontend Chatbot.svelte currently shows generic $tr('chat_error') for ALL non-ok responses, masking the 503 reason. i18n keys live in Public/frontend-v6/src/lib/i18n.ts (en + hi objects), consumed via $tr(). Budget logic in chatGuards.js tokenBudgetExceeded()/recordTokens(); default budget in config.js (~line 89) chatDailyTokenBudget = parseInt(opt('CHAT_DAILY_TOKEN_BUDGET','200000'),10)||200000. Prompt built by summarizePortalData()/buildYearScopedContext()/buildFullContext() in publicData.js with SUMMARY_MAX_CHARS=6000 and per-section caps (currently slice(0,6) years, top 10 contributors/year, committee slice(0,8), etc).
directory_structure: mgmt/server-render/src/{config.js,server.js,routes/,lib/} + test/*.mjs; Public/frontend-v6/src/lib/{components/,stores/,api/,i18n.ts} with co-located *.test.ts; .github/workflows/ci.yml has the public-frontend-v6 JS-size-budget job.
